dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Don't they ever cause any mischief?

dialogues.speaker: Rodion
dialogues.text: Haha, of course not! Honestly, they're quite the little "witches" themselves...

dialogues.speaker: Rodion
dialogues.text: They shape the snow into perfectly identical piles, hide inside one of them, and then reset all the shoveled snow back to normal after every round.

dialogues.speaker: Rodion
dialogues.text: These cute little fellas really save me a lot of trouble...
